display.description: Cash App 的 Design.md 主题展示，围绕移动端、金融与支付组织页面。

borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Pure-black surfaces with hairline `#1A1A1A` dividers — no shadows, no blur, only contrast

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Divider (`#1F1F1F`): Hairline dividers between Activity rows and list items — barely visible by design.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Hairline (`#2A2A2A`): More visible divider used sparingly on sheets.

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: Near-black canvas (`#000000`) with `#0F0F0F` for slightly elevated surfaces — true black, not warm gray

borders.label: 边框 5 - Border 5
borders.description: The accent is Cash Green (`#00D632`) — a near-traffic-light green that's deliberately too-bright on near-black canvas, the way a neon sign is too-bright in a dark bar. It's the only color that touches money: the Pay button, the $-amount display when valid, the boost glyphs on the Cash Card, and the Bitcoin and Stocks indicators when up. Every other accent is muted by comparison — the Cash Card itself is matte black with a custom Cashtag etched in a single color, the Card tab uses the user's chosen card art as the hero, and the Activity feed alternates between green (received) and gray (sent) with no other chromatic noise.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心
panels.body: 适合在 390×844 画布中预览的移动产品体验。

panels.title: 颜色与字体可复用
panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use {#000000} pure black as the canvas — not warm gray, not {#111}。
建议：Use Cash Green {#00D632} as the ONLY accent — Pay button, success states, active tab glyph。
建议：Set the $-amount in Cash Sans Mono at 96pt+ on the Pay screen — this is the signature。
建议：Use Cash Sans Black (weight 900) for screen titles like "Money", "Card", "Activity"。
建议：Render every $-amount and every $Cashtag in Cash Sans Mono with tabular numerals。
dont: 避免：use blue or navy anywhere — Cash App is anti-bank-app blue。
避免：add shadows — Cash App is flat; depth is fill-color contrast only。
避免：use {#111} or warm dark grays as canvas — pure {#000000} is core。
避免：dim inactive tab icons — Cash App keeps them at full white opacity。
避免：add tab bar labels — this is a hard rule。
